description: Group opposite known edges AD/CB(red7,4) and AB/DC(blue2,3), and bind the two groups to the two portions of AC. The error treats these two nonincident pairs as the triangles constraining AC, giving3<AC<5 and integerAC4. DB remains6 from its actual constraints, so sum10. Careful incidence checking still givesAC5 and total11.
